snippet.title: What'Sub Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
What'Sub out as Early Access! 

A 4-player co-op submarine extraction game where you pilot a rust-bucket submarine into the depths of the Bermuda Triangle to recover treasure from the ocean’s seafloor! 

Gear up, descent, risk everything to bring your haul back to the surface, then dive again to ever deeper levels!

🌊 Check out What'Sub Now 🌊
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4269100?utm_source=youtube
